high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "actorvijay." The background is a solid red color, which gives the post a bold and striking appearance. In the center of the image, there is a yellow rectangular banner with two gray elephants on either side. Between the elephants, there is a circular emblem featuring a red background with a pink flower-like design at the center, surrounded by green stars. This emblem is reminiscent of the logo or symbol associated with the Tamil Nadu state flag, which includes two elephants flanking a central emblem.
